assist.title: Assistance
assist.blurb: Misket can ask a language model for suggestions. It is off until you switch it on, it never applies anything by itself, and everything it proposes is something you accept by clicking it. With nothing configured below, nothing ever leaves this computer.
assist.ollamaPresetHint: A model running on this machine. No key, nothing over the network.
assist.baseUrlHintAnthropic: Leave it empty for Anthropic's own API. Set it to point at a gateway or proxy that speaks the Messages API; Misket adds /v1/messages.
assist.baseUrlHintOpenAi: Anything that speaks the OpenAI chat API: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, a university gateway, OpenAI itself. Misket adds /chat/completions.
assist.apiKeyPastePlaceholder: Paste a key to store it
assist.keySaved: API key saved to the system keychain.
assist.keyHint: Stored in your operating system's keychain, never in Misket's settings file and never in a project.
assist.keyHintEnvVar: Currently using the key from MISKET_ASSIST_API_KEY.
assist.keyHintNoKeychain: This computer has no usable keychain, so a key typed here lasts only until Misket closes.
assist.toggleDefinition: Suggest a definition for a code
assist.whatGetsSentCodes: Suggesting codes: the passage you selected (up to {{passageChars, number}} characters), one paragraph either side of it (up to {{contextChars, number}} characters each), and your code names with their definitions (up to {{maxCodes, number}}; past that, the ones whose wording is closest to the passage).
assist.whatGetsSentSummarise: Summarising a code: up to {{maxExcerpts, number}} excerpts carrying that code, with the document names, and the code's own name and definition.
assist.whatGetsSentDefinition: Drafting a definition: the same excerpts, for one code with at least {{minExcerpts, number}} of them.
assist.whatGetsSentNever: Never a whole document, never the project, never your memos, never anything for a feature you have not switched on.
assist.anthropicWarning: Anthropic is a service on the internet. If your ethics approval or data agreement does not allow sending this material off the machine, use the Local (Ollama) preset instead.
assist.showLog_one: Show what was sent ({{count, number}} this session)
assist.showLog_other: Show what was sent ({{count, number}} this session)
assist.hideLog_one: Hide what was sent ({{count, number}} this session)
assist.hideLog_other: Hide what was sent ({{count, number}} this session)

log.footer: Sizes and times only — the list never holds the text itself, so it is safe to show anyone. It covers this session; it is not written to disk.

ocr.title: OCR languages
ocr.intro: Scanned PDFs are recognised with on-device OCR. English (eng) is built in; for another language, download its .traineddata file from the tessdata_fast project and drop it into this folder, then reopen Settings:

you.title: You
you.name: Name
you.nameHint: Recorded next to every change you make and on every code you apply, so a shared file says who did what. Leave it empty to use your computer's user name.
you.colourHint: How your coding is marked when more than one person has worked on a project.
you.coderIdHint: Share this with nobody; it just tells copies apart. It is generated once on this computer and never changes, which is how Misket can later merge a colleague's copy of a project into yours without mixing up whose coding is whose.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.sendCrashReportsHint: When something breaks, sends the app version, your OS, the error message and stack, and the last 50 log lines (any file path in them replaced with a short hash) to the address below. Never sent: your document text, codes, memos or file names — and nothing at all unless an address is set here too.
diagnostics.reportEndpointHint: Left empty (the default), reporting stays off no matter what is checked above. A maintainer running their own GlitchTip- or Sentry-compatible collector puts its URL here.
